snippet.title: Tomo is coming to Nintendo Switch 2!
snippet.description:
Final days on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/onibi/tomoendlessblue?ref=bqhp2v

Tomo: Endless Blue Nintendo Switch 2 porting is starting!

Set sail across a vast ocean of procedural islands in a monster-taming RPG where you can catch, train, and battle rare Tomo, build cozy homes, craft wild contraptions, and explore with friends.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301510/Tomo_Endless_Blue/

Join our Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/tomoendlessblue

Nintendo Switch 2 version planned, subject to Nintendo approval and platform requirements.

#TomoEndlessBlue #NintendoSwitch2 #MonsterTaming
